Results.ReviewText: Apparently, a "basic" grill these days costs about $500 - which to me is expensive.  But, this is a good grill.  I think the most important things is that the grates are thick and ceramic coated - so they are durable and easy to clean.  There are "flavor bars," which are not advertised as a feature - they are triangular bars below the grate that collect grease/juice and increase smoke/flavor in the grill.  These were necessary for me, because I usually use a charcoal grill and/or pellet smoker, and so the flavor bars add a bit of smoky flavor to the mix.  I also like that it has rubber feet on the bottom of the lid so it doesn't slam.
Results.Title: $500 is expensive for a basic grill, but it's Good

Results.ReviewText:
I thought hard about purchasing the Spirit II Weber grill.  It is far from the least expensive grill of its size and capabilities on the market.  Not having purchased a gas grill for many years I did some research before deciding.  Reading reviews and looking carefully at various grills.  It was clear that Weber stands out in quality and customer service.

Once I decided on the Spirit II, because it fit my needs best of the Weber line, I chose to assemble it myself.  This was remarkably easy.  I am elderly but reasonably handy and everything fit together perfectly.  I only needed a second person (my wife) for two minor steps where her help was mainly needed for safety.  I assembled the grill on my deck and there are small parts that can vanish through decking -- watch out!

With the grill assembled, propane canister purchased and all connections tested as advised in the manual (I didn't need the video assistance available but it was nice to have it if needed), it was time to fire it up.  Again, the starting process worked perfectly and the grill quickly heated to 550 F.

Now having used it for several weeks and numerous dinners, I can confidently say the purchase was an excellent choice and well worth the investment.  Combined with the iGrill Bluetooth thermometers, it makes grilling a breeze.  I haven't tried anything really hard but I can, at this point, confidently say that I'm enjoying my new grill and hope do so for a long time to come!
Results.Title: Glad I Purchased the Weber Spirit II Propane Grill
